scope.future_policy: Only explicitly fictional successors after cutoff; no invented historical terms or predictions about real people.
scope.claim: All four exact opening parties researched. Regular parliamentary leadership chronology with documented gaps, not all Australian parties or finished art.
scope.unrepresented_parties: Greens, One Nation, Country Liberal Party, Queensland LNP identity, United Australia, Katter's Australian Party, Centre Alliance and other omitted parties require distinct reviewed IDs/affiliations. Do not allocate fabricated opening support.

ingestion.runtime_prerequisite: Every new term is party-only. Preserve Bob Hawke's seated executive binding. Separate Governor-General appointment and House-confidence review is required before executive eligibility. Organisational president and parliamentary party leader are different mandates; neither silently becomes PM.
ingestion.people: Compatible Person fields; preserve existing Bob Hawke identity/native/birth. Only evidenced life dates supplied.
ingestion.parties: Four exact separate baseline party rows; Liberal and Nationals are not collapsed into one leader. State parties and organisational structures remain separate review.
ingestion.intervals: Half-open [from,until). Incoming leader owns the transition day when both boundaries refer to the same transition. Inclusive final-day statements without an incoming transition are converted to next-day exclusive bounds. Coarse dates deliberately express uncertainty.
ingestion.affiliations: Office windows only, not lifetime memberships or future promotion grants.
ingestion.scope_clipping: 1990-01-01 bounds are opening scope clips, not original election dates.
ingestion.missing_life_dates: Omitted life facts are unknown; do not infer that a real person remains alive or eligible.
ingestion.open_terms: Verified only through 2026-09-07. Future transitions require fictional metadata.

Federal party term begins 1 July 1999; Deputy PM office starts 20 July. 2003 branding transition does not imply a new identity.
November 2007 resignation day/continued caretaker mandate need final verification; no ministerial endpoint substituted.

Personal statement of 10 March expresses intention to resign and asks a party-room meeting; exact effective instant not assumed. Canavan elected 11 March.

research_issues.detail: All exact starter rows have real leaders, but omitted modern parties and transient acting mandates remain gaps. No future fictional identities are created in this source research artifact.

Parliamentary summaries contain discrepancies: Keating Dec1991, Hewson Apr1990, Fischer Apr1990 and Jul1999, Truss Feb2016. Individual party-role biographies and contemporary announcements take precedence. Unresolved Fischer starting day remains coarse.
Current president Leonie Green is not a parliamentary leader. No modern organisational term is backfilled into the 2008–2026 gap, and no party president is automatically prime-minister eligible.

New party terms are separately reviewed party-only data. Missing life dates cannot be used as implicit alive status. Preserve existing game facts on merge; staged life corrections need the explicitly reviewed path.

Original Senate announcements support conservative office clips for Greig (26 August2002) and Bartlett after temporary absence (10 February2004). The earlier actual appointments/resumption remain explicitly unverified.
